events.title: Google makes a fresh bet on nuclear power as the AI energy crunch intensifies

events.title: PTC Rises on Schneider Electric’s $23.7 Billion Takeover Deal | Closing Bell

events.title_fr: PTC et Constellation Energy s'envolent sur fond de méga-accords
